title: Pocketwire Advance Repayment Reserve on Personal Account Balance Transfers
content:
A customer with a Pocketwire Advance line whose repayment is close has part of the Pocketwire Personal Account balance kept back when the whole available balance is transferred out.

**Rule.** The advance repayment reserve on the available transfer amount reads the customer's Pocketwire Advance line and the due date of its most recent advance disbursement: for a line in active status whose due date is from 0 to 3 calendar days after the handling date, 100 percent of the line's outstanding balance is kept back; for an active line whose due date is more than 3 and at most 10 calendar days away, 50 percent is kept back; otherwise nothing is kept back. The amount kept back is rounded to the cent (half up). The most recent advance disbursement is the one with the latest entry date on the line's ledger.

| Pocketwire Advance line | Calendar days from the handling date to the due date | Kept back |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Due date before the handling date | Nothing |
| Active | 0 (due on the handling date) to 3 | 100 percent of the outstanding balance |
| Active | 4 to 10 | 50 percent of the outstanding balance |
| Active | 11 or more | Nothing |
| Any status other than active | Any | Nothing |
| No line, or no advance disbursement | — | Nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical figures)**

- Active line, outstanding balance 420.00, due in 2 days: 420.00 kept back.
- Same line, due in 7 days: 210.00 kept back.
- Active line, outstanding balance 333.33, due in 10 days: 166.665, rounded half up to 166.67.
- Active line due 3 days ago: nothing kept back.
